package sample

import (
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/attachments"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/auth/challenge"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/codec"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/encrypted"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/orm"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/relation"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/decimal"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/metadata"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/model"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/temporal"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/translations"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/value"
)

type Destination struct{ Name string }

//foundry:model table=withdrawals var=Withdrawals key=ID
type Withdrawal struct {
	ID             model.ID[Withdrawal]
	AmountUSD      decimal.Decimal `foundry:"role=column"`
	PayoutAmount   decimal.Decimal `foundry:"role=number"`
	BankSnapshot   encrypted.JSON[Destination]
	OptionalSecret value.Nullable[encrypted.Text]
	PaidAt         value.Nullable[temporal.DateTime]
}

//foundry:model table=entity_lifecycle_events var=EntityLifecycleEvents key=ID hooks=eventHooks retrieval=eventRetrieval scopes=eventScopes softdeletes=none
type EntityLifecycleEvent struct {
	ID         model.ID[EntityLifecycleEvent]
	ReopensOn  value.Nullable[temporal.Date]
	OccurredAt temporal.DateTime
	LocalAt    temporal.LocalDateTime
	Time       temporal.Time
	Interval   temporal.Interval
}

func eventHooks() orm.Hooks[EntityLifecycleEvent] { return orm.Hooks[EntityLifecycleEvent]{} }
func eventRetrieval() orm.RetrievalHooks[EntityLifecycleEvent] {
	return orm.RetrievalHooks[EntityLifecycleEvent]{}
}
func eventScopes(t EntityLifecycleEventTable) []orm.GlobalScope[EntityLifecycleEvent] { return nil }

//foundry:model table=experiment_units var=ExperimentUnits key=ID identity=false timestamps=none
type ExperimentUnit struct {
	ID        model.ID[ExperimentUnit]
	CreatedAt temporal.DateTime
}

//foundry:model table=entities var=Entities key=ID
type Entity struct {
	ID          model.ID[Entity]
	RegistryID  string `foundry:"input=string"`
	PublicMedia attachments.Many[Entity]
	DeletedAt   value.Nullable[temporal.DateTime] `foundry:"role=soft-delete"`
}

func (Entity) MutateRegistryID(v string) (string, error) { return v, nil }

//foundry:model table=projects var=Projects key=ID
type Project struct {
	ID         model.ID[Project]
	Summary    translations.Text
	Settings   metadata.Value[Destination]
	Files      attachments.One[Project]
	Opaque     Destination `foundry:"slot"`
	OriginalID attachments.ID[Entity]
	PublicID   value.Nullable[attachments.ID[Entity]]
	Revision   challenge.Revision[Project]
	Parent     relation.One[Project]
	Children   relation.Many[Project]
	Through    relation.Through[Project, Entity]
	Count      relation.Value[int64]
}

type Email string

func emailCodec() codec.Codec[Email]    { return codec.String[Email]() }
func normalize(v string) (Email, error) { return Email(v), nil }

//foundry:model table=names var=Names key=Code identity=false
type Name struct {
	Code   string `foundry:"key-role=primary-text,member=Code"`
	Email  Email  `foundry:"input=string,mutate=normalize,codec=emailCodec"`
	Hidden bool   `foundry:"member=none"`
}
